idListConvention: UTF-8 LF, one stable ID per line, final LF when nonempty

context.nodeRule: All accepted IDs sharing an exact compiled node name with a corrected ID
context.uiRule: Contact labels and consumable item names are included as their distinct UI consumer families

repetitions: Every accepted ID with a Russian source exactly equal to one of the nine corrected Russian sources
runtimeBindings: Corrected or same-node/contact/item context IDs with protected spans, UI/ChecksDialogs bindings, or format slots; nontranslatable commands and dynamic callbacks remain separate evidence
mandatoryRegressions: Reproduce every cycle-01 mandatory group, then extend the gender/kinship/address group by Russian pronoun-bearing rows in the new containing exchanges; retain all UI, static, ChecksDialogs, protected and mixed-script groups

explicitlyInvalidatedPrior.reason: The prior review read the preceding mushroom-growth line with the next line incorrectly treating Их as mushrooms. The corrected clumps-of-malice antecedent changes the relation between these two lines; recheck this previously reviewed transition.

regressionCases.name: notice-noun-versus-order-variants
regressionCases.rule: All inflected order actions and the UI document noun must remain in the current closure; the action targets are not overwritten by the noun.

regressionCases.name: mushroom-pronoun-antecedent
regressionCases.rule: The compiled preceding line about clumps of malice in mycelium must be selected even though the corrected line itself contains only Их and гриб.

regressionCases.name: bestson-breastfeeding-cause
regressionCases.rule: The breastfeeding/calcium statement in the same conditional arm must be selected as context for the corrected dental consequence.

regressionCases.name: beer-ad-intervening-line
regressionCases.rule: The line between the two brother references must be selected by compiled node topology, not flattened source adjacency.

retiredDependencyRule: Prior closure IDs absent from the current closure are recorded with their former components; they are not reread unless explicitly invalidated.
